visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of several small red teacups decorated with gold Chinese 'Xi' characters, resting on a red tray. White text overlays the bottom of the frame indicating a date and an engagement ceremony name. (2) A woman in a traditional red bridal Kua with intricate gold embroidery appears, assisted by an older woman in a red patterned dress. They walk together through a brightly lit indoor venue as guests clap in the background. (3) The bride is shown kneeling or bowing while serving tea from the red tray to an elderly woman seated in a red chair. The setting is a hotel-like event space with beige padded walls and a group of smiling relatives. (4) A medium shot captures the bride and a bald man (the groom) in a black traditional Chinese jacket laughing together during the ceremony. The groom receives a cup of tea as onlookers capture the moment on smartphones. (5) The bride serves tea to a row of people, including children who are laughing and clapping enthusiastically. The lighting is warm and even. (6) A medium close-up shows a woman in a white dress wiping a tear from her eye with a tissue while watching the ceremony. (7) Close-up shot of the groom placing a gold ring onto the bride's finger. (8) A large crowd gathers for a group photograph, with everyone cheering, raising their arms, and holding red paper 'Xi' signs. (9) A montage follows showing the couple walking up a staircase, then the bride sitting in a decorated room, and finally a black and white shot of them walking hand-in-hand down a hallway. (10) The final scene shows the couple hugging and kissing on a balcony with a glass railing, looking out over a city street on a grey, overcast day.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 2 main creators (bride and groom), approximately 15 guests in the group shot, and a few kids.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The bride wears a traditional red Chinese wedding gown (Qipao/Kua) with elaborate gold embroidery and a floral hairpiece. The groom has a bald head and wears a black traditional jacket with gold dragon motifs.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A luxury hotel or event space featuring beige upholstered walls, red carpets, wooden door frames, and a balcony with a glass railing overlooking a busy city street.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Sentimental acoustic guitar and piano BGM begins softly, accompanied by a low-level ambient indoor room tone. (2) A clear female voice in Mandarin speaks politely, inviting her mother to drink tea. An older woman's voice responds with a warm, joyful blessing. (3) Sounds of rhythmic hand clapping and collective cheering from a crowd rise in volume. A child's distinct giggle is heard during a transition. (4) High-arousal vocal interaction occurs between the bride and groom; both are heard laughing clearly. The BGM remains steady in the background. (5) The bride speaks again in a cheerful tone, addressing her husband. This is met with another burst of applause and collective 'Xi' cheering from the guests. (6) A male singer's voice in English starts the chorus of a pop ballad, becoming the dominant audio element as spoken dialogue ends. The track maintains a high-valence, romantic mood until the final fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Event Highlights -> Emotional Climax -> Stylized Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a sentimental and joyful highlight reel of a traditional Chinese engagement ceremony, showcasing the tea ceremony, family blessings, and the couple's romantic connection.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video combines documentary-style event coverage with cinematic, slow-motion portraits, effectively capturing both the cultural significance and the personal emotions of the wedding day.
